data_point: Announced a funding round in the last six months
run_when: Web search results about the company's funding are available.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company announced a funding round in the last six months, including seed extensions, bridges and SAFE rounds.
prompt.definition: Count from today's date given in the context.
yes_when: A dated announcement of a round within the last six months
no_when: The latest announced round is older than six months
watch_out_for: Make sure the news is about this company, not one with a similar name
Use the announcement date, not the article date if different

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: March 3, 2026: Acme raises $6M seed extension led by Initialized

output.evidence_quote: Acme raises $6M seed extension led by Initialized
output.reason: A seed extension was announced within six months.
